orders.text:
AO No.115 of 2013 
Hon’ble B.S. Verma, J.
Heard Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for the appellant. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the respondents. 
Summon the lower court record. 
List thereafter. 
Also heard on the stay application no.2222 of 
2013. 
If the appellant deposits the entire awarded amount 
(minus statutory deposit) with the MACT concerned within 
a period of eight weeks, the execution of the impugned 
award shall remain stayed. (Stay application is disposed 
of). 
 (B.S. Verma, J.) 
 18.03.2013 
Rajni

CLMA No. 4488 of 2013
CLMA No. 4489 of 2013
 In
AO No. 115 of 2013
 
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Shri I.P.Kohli, Advocate, present for the
appellant.
Shri Hari Mohan Bhatia, Advocate,
present for the claimant/respondent no.1. 
This is Money Withdrawal Application
No. 4489 of 2013 moved on behalf of the
claimant for release of the amount of
compensation deposited by the appellant
before Motor Accident Claims
Tribunal/Additional District Judge, Haldwani,
in Motor Accident Claim Case No. 124 of
2005.
Heard.
Having heard learned counsel for the
appellant, and learned counsel for the
claimant/respondent, it is directed that `
3,50,000/- be released in favour of the
claimant/respondent no.1, out of the sum
deposited by the appellant before the Tribunal
concerned. The release of rest of the amount
shall remain stayed as directed by this Court
vide its order dated 18.03.2013, which may be
kept in the Fixed Deposits to avoid the loss of
interest. (Money Withdrawal Application No.
4489 of 2013 stands disposed of. 
List this appeal for final hearing in due
course alongwith the cross objection, if any. 
 
 (P.C.Pant,J.)
 
10-05-2013
NP
